content: I was debugging a proof mode issue and eventually traced it to fromForall_plainly. My problem can be resolved by changing {α : Type _} to {α : Sort _}. I’ve widened this and the relevant upstream lemmas in Sbi.lean and Plainly.lean and it seems to work. I’m curious why this restriction was made. Perhaps @Markus de Medeiros could help me with this?
I don't think I actually tried generalizing from Type to Sort here (I guess I habitually write Type). Feel free to make the change!
